description: Report which server slots are free to deploy into, with their RAM, and how many servers the account may keep in total. A saved server can only be deployed into a free slot, and a new one can only be created while under the server limit. Call this before deploy_instance or create_instance so you can tell the user why either is or is not possible, rather than having it fail.
name: get_available_slots
title: Get Available Server Slots
